teacher_single_assignment.name: Teacher Single Assignment Constraint
teacher_single_assignment.description: Prevents teachers from being assigned to multiple rooms in the same time slot
teacher_single_assignment.impact: Ensures teachers aren't double-booked, which is critical for a valid timetable
teacher_single_assignment.where: T = number of teachers, D = number of days, S = number of slots, R = number of rooms

no_overlapping_slots.name: No Overlapping Slots Constraint
no_overlapping_slots.description: Prevents teachers from being assigned to lab and theory slots that overlap in time
no_overlapping_slots.impact: Ensures teachers can't physically be in two places at once when lab slots overlap with theory slots
no_overlapping_slots.note: Each lab slot (1hr:50min) overlaps with two theory slots (50min each)

course_hours.name: Course Hours Constraint
course_hours.description: Ensures each course gets allocated the required lecture and practical hours
course_hours.impact: Critical for educational outcomes - ensures students receive the proper instructional time
course_hours.complexity: O(T × C × (D × S_theory × R_classroom + D × S_lab × R_lab))
course_hours.where: C = number of courses per teacher

room_single_assignment.name: Room Single Assignment Constraint
room_single_assignment.description: Prevents rooms from being assigned to multiple teachers in the same time slot
room_single_assignment.impact: Ensures rooms aren't double-booked, preventing scheduling conflicts
room_single_assignment.complexity: O((R_classroom × D × S_theory + R_lab × D × S_lab) × T)
room_single_assignment.note: Physical constraint - a room can only host one class at a time
